value: The Rim Dispatch has paused its reporting efforts into Lowmere, citing an unconfirmed lack of reliable information from the settlement. Meanwhile, the Black Fen Raiders managed to burn a ferry operating on the south channel. Such disruption is hardly surprising given the increased piracy activity. Separately, the Rim Dispatch itself is currently searching for the whereabouts of its own reporter, Tomas Quell. One wonders what kind of hazards have led to such a sudden absence. The Brine Coast League remains silent on the matter, as does everyone else regarding Lowmere’s internal workings.
